title: Conditional Prediction Tree Tracker
dataSources: Forecasts (`prediction:forecast`), resolved outcomes (`prediction:outcome`), personal bets (`bet:personal`), calibration scores (`calibration:score`), Brier scores (`brier:score`).
app: Personal forecasting and calibration — a private prediction journal of dated forecasts about your own life, resolved outcomes, and calibration / Brier scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prediction:forecast parent_prediction_id=*
| stats count as child_predictions, values(condition_label) as conditions by parent_prediction_id
| sort - child_predictions
description: Tracks forecasts that branch into conditional sub-predictions when outcomes depend on earlier events.
value: Complex personal planning often hinges on contingencies, and prediction trees make those assumptions visible.
implementation: Use `parent_prediction_id` on dependent forecasts and summarize branch count and condition labels by parent prediction.
visualization: Table of parent forecasts with conditional branch count.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which predictions have grown into branching what-if trees instead of a single yes-or-no call.
